name: framepack
description: A lightweight HyperFrames creative workbench for assets, prompts, composition, audit gates, and iteration.
readme:
# Framepack

Framepack is a programmatic video workbench for coding agents and HyperFrames. It turns rough ideas, user assets, references, and fuzzy taste words into a professional video plan, then guides create, workbench brief, audit, build, preview, render, and iteration.

中文: Framepack 是程式化视频工作台。它把外行的模糊审美愿望翻译成 agent 能执行、HyperFrames 能生产的专业视频方案，并用主动介入上下文、审计门禁、项目偏好、摩擦记录和迭代记忆监督整个流程。

Quick path:

```bash
npm install framepack
npx framepack create --idea "A premium launch video" --assets ./assets --output-dir ./out --project-name launch-video
npx framepack workbench brief --project-dir ./out/launch-video
npx framepack workbench audit --phase all --project-dir ./out/launch-video --json
npx framepack build --project-dir ./out/launch-video
npx framepack preview --project-dir ./out/launch-video --open
```
